index.summary: Implement the owner-approved collaboration-oriented review experience.

product.objective: Help users and agents record actual reviews, inspect review facts and find useful next commands while retaining caller-controlled decisions.

index.summary: Review record, status and bounded history with actionable diagnostics.

deliverable.description: Optional review result recording in existing task records, XML/human status/history, compact task context, compatible formal review guidance, tests and current repository Skill/documentation.

included.item: Task review Core and CLI, context/read formatting, tests and current documentation/Skill.

excluded.item: New XML schemas, automatic lifecycle decisions from recorded results, new mandatory review requirements, unrelated backlog research and Git pushes.

index.summary: Implement the review experience plan approved by the owner.

requirement.statement: Add task review record/status/records, optional declared results, factual context summaries and actionable diagnostics. Reuse informational discussion records and retain existing formal submission semantics and error/exit codes.
requirement.rationale: The owner selected a convenience-oriented workflow and explicitly requested implementation after reviewing the concrete plan.

acceptance.criterion: Review notes work across task states, results do not change lifecycle or formal approval, XML/human history/status and context are accurate, retries/dry-run behave correctly, existing formal review flows remain valid, and build/tests and documentation are current.

constraints.constraint: Review notes/results and actor metadata are optional conveniences. Record results never automatically change task status, criteria, blockers, review configuration or formal approval. Users and agents choose subsequent actions.
Reuse current schemas and transaction/revision/replay rules. Preserve formal review semantics and existing diagnostic/exit codes while improving messages and command guidance.
